messages:
maria (pm): Quick sync — proposing an SLA-tiered routing + preemptive drain playbook for Dedicated pools. Want to capture acceptance criteria and rollout gates before we scope the EPIC.

jason (eng): +1. can you sketch the core idea?

maria (pm): high level: requests land on pool by SLA tier (gold/silver/bronze). If pool pressure gets high we do 3 steps: 1) soft-degrade (increase batching / allow longer tail), 2) preemptive drain noncritical sessions, 3) spillover to compatible hosted variants with throttled ramp.

sophie (infra): need to be explicit about preemptive drain: who is eligible, drain window, and metric triggers. otherwise oncall will hate us.

alex (se): customers want guaranteed headroom during launches — can we map tiers to reserved token bands so gold keeps X% headroom?

maria (pm): yes. proposal: gold = 15% reserved headroom, silver = 7%, bronze = 0. headroom enforced by admission control and predictive pre-warm triggers.

ron (sales): flag: enterprise legal will want contract language for "preemptive drain" — can we limit to non-production sessions + provide 1hr notice for human-facing apps?

jason (eng): implementation sketch:
```
route_selector {
  if (tier == \"gold\") weight = 100;
  if (tier == \"silver\") weight = 70;
  if (tier == \"bronze\") weight = 30;
}
preemptive_drains {
  trigger: cpu_util > 85% || queue_len > 500
  target: sessions tagged as non-critical || batch jobs
  grace_period: 120s
}
spillover {
  target_model: compatible_hosted_variant
  ramp: 5% -> 50% over 10m
  throttle: token_rate_limit = 2000/s
}
```

sophie (infra): need to add observability hooks: per-tenant drained count, average drain latency, spilled_tokens, and a health-check that verifies target hosted variant is healthy before spillover.

maria (pm): agreed. rollout gates: 1) infra e2e test for drain choreography, 2) chaos test that simulates 2x normal qps, 3) customer pilot with 1 major customer for 2 weeks.

alex (se): for pilot we should expose toggles: on/off, drain-only-noninteractive, and max-spill %. customers will want control.

ron (sales): also capture SLOs during pilot: 95p latency increase cap for gold (<=10%), and clear billing notes when spillover to hosted happens.

jason (eng): open engineering risks: preemptive drain correctness (race between admission and drain), spin-up time for hosted variants, and fair weighting when multiple pools are near threshold.

maria (pm): prioritization ask: we recommend M1 -> policy + admission control + telemetry (2 sprints), M2 -> preemptive drain + safe rollout (3 sprints), M3 -> spillover automation + contract docs (2 sprints). total ~7 sprints.

sophie (infra): ops checklist items: runbook for escalations, synthetic test that validates spillover decisions every 1h, and a dashboard with a 5m and 1h view.

alex (se): one more: UX for customers to opt into "grace windows" so they can pause drains during launches. quick API:
```
POST /v1/dedicated/pools/:id/grace-window
{ "start": "2025-06-01T15:00Z", "duration_mins": 60 }
```

maria (pm): acceptance criteria (short):
- feature gates present and toggleable per-tenant
- preemptive drain triggers tested under load and documented
- telemetry: drained_sessions, spilled_tokens, post-spill latency deltas
- pilot completed with one customer and ratified contract language

ron (sales): i'll start draft contract language + pilot ask. tagging legal next. @maria please add customer contact list.

jason (eng): I'll stub the admission-control PR and add tests for the trigger heuristics.

sophie (infra): I'll create the dashboard skeleton and runbook.

maria (pm): thanks all. next step: sync tomorrow 11am to finalize M1 scope. if anyone can't make it drop notes here. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: deployment scheduled: routing-policy-service v0.12 -> staging at 2025-03-12T02:15:00Z

alex (se): noted, will review staging config.

maria (pm): leaving this thread open for questions and any additional acceptance items.
